text:
maya (PM): Short check-in — final acceptance gate for the inference launch. Need owners for SLA blurb, monitoring alerts, runbook snippet, pricing footnote, and a staging rehearsal. Can owners callify?

eli (SRE): I'll take SLOs + alert expressions + fallback routing policy. Two asks: confirm hosted vs dedicated floor numbers, and permission to run a staged traffic-steer rehearsal.

frank (Product): Product can accept a looser p99 for 32k-context models if it's explicit in docs. Also want a single-sentence response Sales can use for prospects about Dedicated SLAs.

sarah (Sales): Give me one line: "Dedicated deployments can include contractual SLAs; details and credits negotiated with account." That keeps legal safe.

zoe (Docs): I'll publish the public GA readiness page and an internal runbook. I need the exact promql alerts and the CLI/API snippet to trigger fallback. ETA Friday if I get those.

eli (SRE): Proposed SLOs (draft): hosted: availability=99.95%, latency_p99<=350ms. dedicated: availability=99.9%, latency_p99<=500ms. Private: contractual. Will paste promql: (sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05.

maya (PM): Good. Who drafts the credit formula?

sarah (Sales): I'll draft a simple internal credit calc (hours_down * % of committed throughput), then pass to legal.

oncall-bot: Reminder — runbook template saved at /runbooks/model-regression; use section "fallback" for CLI examples.

eli (SRE): CLI example for fallback (example): redwood traffic shift --from model-big --to model-safe --reason error_budget_burn. I'll add exact flags to the runbook.

frank (Product): Launch criteria (Product): docs live + runbook in #eng-oncall, SLO doc committed, oncall rota for GA week, and provisional pricing page with footnote for Dedicated/private. Premium SLA lane is post-GA.

zoe (Docs): I'll link the runbook to the acceptance sheet once draft is ready.

maya (PM): Action items: eli finalize SLOs+alerts+CLI (due Thu EOD), zoe publish docs+runbook draft (due Fri), sarah draft credit language (due Mon), oncall-bot confirm rota (due Thu). If no objections by Thu EOD we'll mark "ready for greenlight" and schedule readout.

eli (SRE): ack, will also run a traffic-steer test in staging during burnin.

frank (Product): ack.

sarah (Sales): ack.

zoe (Docs): ack, will ping for review.
